title: ReqLab — Product roadmap
description: A local-first API testing workspace for thoughtful developers.

items.title: Design system, product landing & bilingual experience
items.body: Responsive product presentation, Tailwind CSS, local fonts, English/Persian with RTL, and persistent light/dark preferences.

items.title: Request composition & response inspection
items.body: HTTP methods, URL interpolation, headers, JSON/text bodies, abortable requests, formatted responses and timing.

items.title: Collections, environments & history
items.body: Manage collections, environment variables, request replay, history filters and safe collection deletion.

items.title: Local persistence & portable backups
items.body: Versioned Zod validation, cross-tab synchronization, storage error feedback, validated JSON import and full-workspace export.

items.title: Automated verification & portfolio documentation
items.body: Production build, strict TypeScript, ESLint, Vitest domain tests, and Playwright browser tests. Real screenshots and architecture documentation.

items.title: Explore collection runner and assertions
items.body: Optional future iteration; outside the implemented v1 scope.

items.title: Publish a public deployment
items.body: Choose a hosting provider and connect this repository. No deployment has been created by this setup.
